title: Guarded Workflow Kanban Board
summary: Move work through a guarded approval board. Returning an item to draft records the reviewer’s reason.
interactionSpecs: Move a card with drag-and-drop or its destination control.
A transition map rejects illegal moves and the card stays in its original lane.
Review → Draft requires a note. A per-card lock guards an in-flight move.
codeLivewirePhp:
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class GuardedWorkflowKanban extends Component
{
    private const EDGES = ['Draft' => ['Review'], 'Review' => ['Draft', 'Approved'], 'Approved' => []];

    #[Locked]
    public array $cards = [
        'WR-18' => ['title' => 'Renewal brief', 'lane' => 'Draft', 'reason' => ''],
        'WR-24' => ['title' => 'Site return', 'lane' => 'Review', 'reason' => ''],
        'WR-31' => ['title' => 'Baseline plan', 'lane' => 'Approved', 'reason' => ''],
    ];
    #[Locked]
    public string $returning = '';
    public string $note = '';
    public string $message = '';

    public function requestMove(string $id, string $target): void
    {
        if (!isset($this->cards[$id])) return;
        $current = $this->cards[$id]['lane'];
        if (!in_array($target, self::EDGES[$current], true)) {
            $this->message = "$id stays in $current. This transition is unavailable.";
            return;
        }
        if ($target === 'Draft') {
            $this->returning = $id;
            $this->note = '';
            $this->dispatch('request-return-note');
            return;
        }
        $this->cards[$id]['lane'] = $target;
        $this->message = "$id moved to $target.";
    }

    public function confirmReturn(): void
    {
        $id = $this->returning;
        $this->note = trim($this->note);
        $this->validate(['note' => 'required|string|max:300']);
        if (($this->cards[$id]['lane'] ?? '') !== 'Review') return;
        $this->cards[$id]['lane'] = 'Draft';
        $this->cards[$id]['reason'] = $this->note;
        $this->message = "$id moved to Draft.";
        $this->returning = '';
        $this->dispatch('return-recorded');
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.guarded-workflow-kanban', ['lanes' => array_keys(self::EDGES)]);
    }
}
